Teen program, ages 15 to 17

THE ROUTE
TO A LICENSE.

Every Greenlight student follows the same route, from the learner license to the road test at the DPS office. You always know which stop you are at and what comes next.

Classroom

32 hours online

Behind the wheel

44 hours

Learner license held

6 months before the test

How the teen program works

01

LEARNER LICENSE

Age 15 and up, at the DPS office

Finish the first classroom modules, pass the knowledge test and pick up your learner license. We help with the paperwork.

02

CLASSROOM

32 hours, online, self-paced

Laws, signs and safe habits in short lessons on a laptop or phone. Most teens finish in six to eight weeks.

03

BEHIND THE WHEEL

44 hours: 14 with us, 30 with a parent

Your instructor rides in the passenger seat with a brake of their own. After every lesson, parents get a text with what to practice next.

04

MOCK ROAD TEST

90 minutes on real test routes

A full test on the streets around the DPS office, scored the way an examiner scores it, with time left to fix what cost points.

05

ROAD TEST

Test day, in our car if you want it

A warm-up drive, the dual-brake car and your instructor waiting at the testing office. Then you drive away licensed.

BEFORE THE
ROAD TEST,
EVERY TEEN
DRIVES

44 HOURS

14 hours with a Greenlight instructor

30 hours with a parent, 10 of them after dark

We log every hour. After each lesson, parents get a text with what went well and what to practice before the next one.

Do I need a learner license before my first lesson?

Yes. You’ll need a learner license or a valid license to drive on public roads. We help teens with the paperwork, and the office can walk adults through the steps.
